inputs.text: Listen to this: They're rolling this out as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, pushing legislation that forces guns sold in New York to be built so they can't be easily modified into illegal machine guns, along with criminal penalties for violations. But this is no genuine safety push or accident—it's the elites and institutions coordinating through these state agendas to gradually disarm the public, using the machine gun excuse as a smokescreen while they invert the story to tighten restrictions on legal ownership. It's all about hidden control, and their denials only confirm the real motives are being kept secret.
